name: fux
description: Your repository's fux index in the editor: MCP tools for agent mode, plus search, link hovers, backlinks and archived-link warnings over LSP.

fux.command.description: The fux executable. Install it with `pip install fux-engine` (or `fux-reader`), or give its full path.

fux.mcp.enable.description: Register `fux mcp` for every workspace folder that has a .fux/index.

fux.lsp.enable.description: Run `fux lsp` for every workspace folder that has a .fux/index.

fux.search.debounceMs.description: How long `Fux: Search the index` waits after a keystroke before it searches.
